price_information: Unknown future price by default; observed only at interval_end <= decision_time. Perfect-price branches are explicitly hypothetical.
settlement: All contracted and emergency energy settled at target interval actual price; final effective quantity billed once relative to midnight original. No advance price locking.
price_model: OLS intercept, daily Fourier K=2, price lag1day and lag7day, six weekday indicators; last 28 completed days/intervals, re-fit at each allowed decision
price_floor_basis: Predeclared numerical positivity floor, never estimated from future minima; record every activation
forecasts: Q4-2 inherits frozen Q2 selected load and PV forecasts. Q4-3 inherits same load and exact issue PV from Appendix 3. No load or PV re-selection.
initial_state: Common Q2 January warmup February 1 state; actual state continues independently per policy
terminal_state: Each forecast horizon ends at today's midnight actual state; extra baseline assumption, actual state never reset
surplus: Allow free disposal of paid grid and PV, no sale; Q3 planner/executor unchanged
inventory_proxy: Known Appendix1 mean fixed price times discharge efficiency, not realized future average price
design_disclosure: Policy families fixed before this Q4 calculation, after Q2/Q3 annual results were inspected; retrospective evaluation, no full-year retuning or claim of untouched test selection
